verdict.rationale: My DOR holds a business's filings and account data, so a bulk export in open formats is a fair question for this portal. The evidence only shows printing a single confirmation or return submission, which is an adjacent one-off print, not a documented export of all data in open formats. No API or bulk-download capability is evidenced, and the authenticated portal could not be inspected.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
